name: Shinjou Mayumi
source:
Third year student at Higashi Kasumigaoka private school. The elder sister of the main character.

She has excellent grades. She is well behaved. She is good-looking. She is the president of the student government executive committee.

She is a serious and hardworking person who lives up to the expectations of others. She loves Takafumi as her little brother.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/anejoku/index.html]official site[/url]]
